prompt: If $3x + 7 = 22$, what is the value of $x$?
hint: Undo the operations in reverse order: the $+7$ comes off before the $\times 3$.

hints.text: Undo the operations in reverse order: the $+7$ comes off before the $\times 3$.
Subtract $7$ from both sides to get $3x = 15$.

learningObjective: Solve a two-step linear equation in one variable.

alternativeExplanations.title: Backsolve instead
steps: The choices are plain numbers, so test one. Start with B, $x = 5$.
$3(5) + 7 = 22$ ✓ — done, with no algebra at all.
On a timed section this is often faster than solving forward, and it cannot be derailed by a sign error.
